name: dTRINITY dUSD
oneLiner: dUSD is dTRINITY's USD stablecoin minted 1:1 against yield-bearing reserve stablecoins, with Curve AMOs and stability operations defending the peg.
collateral: Ethereum: USDT0/USDC0-style whitelisted stablecoin and yield-bearing collateral in isolated dUSD reserves. Fraxtal: frxUSD/sfrxUSD and other Frax-aligned USD collateral in isolated reserves. Katana: whitelisted USD stablecoins and yieldcoins in isolated reserves. Sonic: whitelisted USD stablecoins/yieldcoins such as frxUSD/sfrxUSD in isolated reserves. Each network deployment maintains fully isolated reserves with no cross-chain collateral sharing.
pegMechanism: Atomic 1:1 mint (no fee) and redemption (up to 50 bps fee) against whitelisted reserve stablecoins; Algorithmic Market Operations (AMO) pre-mint dUSD into Curve liquidity pools to programmatically support the peg; Stability Market Operations (SMO) buy back and burn dUSD from Curve when it trades at a significant discount; dUSD price is hard-coded at $1 in all protocol-internal operations to prevent oracle manipulation.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: dUSD is atomically minted and redeemed against whitelisted dollar-stablecoin reserves, with AMO and SMO operations supporting liquidity.
